description: On-device voice host: libelizainference (llama.cpp/ggml; Paradee-8M TTS with native misaki G2P and eSpeak NG out-of-lexicon fallback, Phonon-2 parakeet-tdt ASR with batch and streaming decode, Silero VAD) through the shared paradee-voice Java API (ai.eliza.voice) and RegisterNatives JNI. The only on-device speech engine; llama.cpp-based, no other neural runtime. These are the exact bytes scripts/android-stage-voice-models.mjs may stage; component evidence is recorded separately from installed-app, hardware audio and user acceptance.

bundle.install: APK assets copied to private storage with SHA-256 verification; Phonon b5x3t7 model is 208,932,352 bytes. No network installation.

asrSlot.current: Pinned Phonon-2/parakeet-tdt model; current native loader selects the in-tree ggml backend. Model architecture and backend registry override are separate.

abis.componentBuild: Upstream paradee-voice builder (scripts/build-pinned-voice.mjs) at pin 3f869454f5 with engine 6337fd4c4b, NDK 28.2.13676358, 2026-11-06 on Linux x86_64 with hash-verified cached models (every model byte identical to the b3eb2bf63b build); not reproduced on a second host. Pins 86a0d19473, c35106fb14 and b25d8aef29 keep the same engine gitlink and change no plugin-local-inference or builder source, so these bytes are carried unchanged to b25d8aef29. From b25d8aef29 to 4787d51a14 (through 4e91de4cc7 and 3a6d22670e) the engine gitlink and the JNI and C++ inputs (elizavoice-jni, stage-elizavoice-lib.ts, the paradee-voice inputs.json) are unchanged, so the library bytes still stand; the shared ai.eliza.voice Java and the builder script changed (see sourceAdmission.developComparison).

evidence.scope: Component requalification at pin 4787d51a14 of engine 6337fd4c4b (libelizainference sha256 49b01a18... arm64-v8a, 128b61f3... x86_64, as listed above) with the upstream qualify app (ai.eliza.voicequalify, AsrWerTest and ParadeeRoundTripTest) rebuilt from the prepared source at 4787d51a14, so it runs the changed shared ai.eliza.voice Java (VoiceAssets, NativeAsr, ParadeeVoice.synthesize through the new per-request cancel path); the app, test and library hashes are in docs/evidence/voice-engine-6337fd4c-4787d51a14/qualify-receipt.json and were read back from both devices after install. Pixel 10a, arm64-v8a, API 37 (2026-11-07): ASR WER 1.94% over 101 LibriSpeech test-clean utterances (limit 6%, silence transcribed empty), ASR RTF 0.042; Paradee round trip WER 4.77% over 230 sentences (limit 8%), TTS RTF 0.055. x86_64 emulator (sdk_gphone64_x86_64, API 35, swiftshader, 2026-11-08): ASR WER 2.13% (limit 6%, silence empty); round trip WER 4.90% (limit 8%). Every transcript is identical to the b25d8aef29 runs on both ABIs (docs/evidence/voice-engine-6337fd4c), which remain recorded. Component evidence only: not the Alpha app, its speech bridge (LocalSpeechBridgePlugin, SpeechOutputWarmup, FirstWriteSpeechOutput, SpeechLeadTrim are compiled into the qualify app but not called), OnDeviceRecognizer's live session, installed-app audio, a live microphone or hardware playback. No Alpha APK of this branch carries local speech yet: the developer lane cannot package the engine while the embedding host requalification is pending (docs/evidence/on-device-speech-2026-11-07/v829-device-check.json). The owner's acceptance (docs/decisions.md P-82, 2026-11-07) covered the b25d8aef29 Java; userAccepted and qualified stay false until the owner re-accepts on this requalification.

acceptance: Engine 6337fd4c4b passed component qualification on both ABIs (Pixel 10a arm64 and x86_64 API 35 emulator, 2026-11-07) with the qualify app built from b25d8aef29. On 2026-11-07 the owner accepted on-device speech on that evidence (P-82). That acceptance was recorded at pin 4e91de4cc7 with the statement that only the engine gitlink carried over from b25d8aef29; in fact the shared speech Java and the builder changed between b25d8aef29 and 4e91de4cc7, and changed again at 3a6d22670e. The changed code: ParadeeVoice (a per-request cancel path around every non-streaming native synthesis call, which the round-trip qualification calls), OnDeviceRecognizer (live recognizer session), ElizaInferencePlugin, LocalSpeechBridgePlugin (speech-output warm-up and its fenced close sites), the new SpeechLeadTrim, SpeechOutputWarmup and FirstWriteSpeechOutput, consumer.gradle, voice-product-inputs.mjs, build-native.ts (language selection) and the stream-contract StreamContract.java. The library bytes are unchanged and their component evidence stands, but the bridge under acceptance changed and was not requalified, so qualified is false until the owner re-accepts the changed bridge or it is requalified and accepted. This was never a measured spoken turn on versionCode 40, a same-day A/B, an AOSP image test or pilot acceptance. Requalification at 4787d51a14 (2026-11-07/08): the qualify app rebuilt at this pin passed on the Pixel 10a and the x86_64 emulator with transcripts identical to the b25d8aef29 runs; it awaits the owner's re-acceptance. On 2026-11-08 the owner accepted the requalified engine and bridge at 4787d51a14 (P-83), so qualified is true. Still not covered: a measured spoken turn on a build from this pin, a same-day spoken A/B against Cloud speech, and the embedding host, whose requalification at this pin is separate.

developComparison.note: Host-side tests, stubs and READMEs under the same trees also changed and are not listed. The engine and JNI inputs are unchanged, so the recorded library bytes stand. The ai.eliza.voice Java changed, including ParadeeVoice.synthesize, which the round-trip qualification exercises, so the b25d8aef29 qualification did not transfer; the qualify app was rerun at 4787d51a14 on both ABIs on 2026-11-07/08 and passed with identical transcripts (evidence.records). No new acceptance has been recorded.
